globals.name: MutationObserver
globals.message: Take it off the document's own window (ownerDocument.defaultView). The global is Node's in a test and another realm's in an iframe, and the widget then watches nothing (docs/decisions/widget.md).

globals.name: navigator
globals.message: Read document.defaultView.navigator. Node's global navigator says en-US, so a binding that reads it passes every test that expects English (docs/decisions/widget.md).

globals.name: fetch
globals.message: Only transport.ts calls fetch. Every other call goes through the transport, or a host's relay is left out with nothing to see (docs/decisions/widget.md).
